description: Create a verified booking for an agent or customer. Automatically mints a Solana State-Compressed NFT (cNFT) Booking Credential and generates a Solana Pay transfer request (USDC/PAB) with an on-chain reference key for 400ms automatic settlement detection via findReference.

customerPhone.description: Customer phone for WhatsApp utility confirmation (optional)

customerWallet.description: Customer Solana wallet address to receive the cNFT booking credential (optional)

serviceId.description: Service ID from pabandi_get_services (optional for general table/venue booking)

name: pabandi_create_booking
